Minimum requirements for the laptop are listed on the department's website.

of.title: Technical Area 1, Biomedical Imaging and Instrumentation

of.text: This technical area is designed for students interested in the general area of medical imaging science and instrumentation design. Two career emphases are available in this area: biomedical imaging and biomedical instrumentation. Students are required to select 12 semester hours from any of the Technical Area 1 electives; six of the 12 hours must be within engineering.
